author: Rod Lamkey
title: U.S. Ambassador to South Africa Summoned Over Criticism
text:
• The South African foreign minister said the new U.S. ambassador to South Africa has been summoned to explain his criticism.
• The criticism is related to foreign policy the Trump administration describes as anti-American and domestic policies it calls anti-white.
• The ambassador, Reuben E. Brigety II, criticized South Africa's stance on Russia.
• Brigety said in a meeting that South Africa's arms supply to Russia was against the law.
• The South African government has previously summoned the U.S. ambassador over the issue.
• The U.S. ambassador has been asked to explain his comments.
• The U.S. State Department has not commented on the matter.
• The South African government views the ambassador's comments as an attack on its foreign policy.
• The ambassador also criticized South Africa's domestic policies.
• The U.S. has previously raised concerns about South Africa's relationship with Russia.
• The U.S. has also raised concerns about South Africa's domestic policies.
• The South African government has denied the allegations.
• The U.S. ambassador has been asked to clarify his remarks.
• The U.S. embassy has not yet responded to requests for comment.
